mechanisms.decisive_claim: Let c=top_3(p) and d=top_3(v). Every actual (++ -> ++) state with gamma4<0 satisfies binom(d,4)-binom(c+1,4)>=U_2(alpha). Since U_3(v)>=binom(d,4) and U_3(p)<=binom(c+1,4)-1, this implies exact gamma5>=0 while retaining the base word.
would_close: the entire actual G++ chamber at rank five
mechanisms.kill_test: Minimize binom(top_3(v),4)-binom(top_3(p)+1,4)-U_2(alpha) on actual moving-wall rows and deep interior compatible offsets; kill on the first negative value.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/adaptive_gamma4_wall_probe.json: 823,476 actual (++ -> ++) negative-gamma4 rows conditioned at target and gamma4 moving walls give no leading-block counterexample; exact minimum margin 84,520. The scan also rediscovers the p-free failure at j=21, proving the retained base is essential. Finite evidence only.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: On every actual G++ cell, transport to a common cubic cap makes the complement loss of p+e no larger than the complement loss of p plus the exact alpha charge.
would_close: G++ by one cap-complement domination inequality
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute both complement losses on consecutive compatible r-values across every observed carry; kill on the first reversal.
mechanisms.status_evidence: The common-cap transport is not specified as an evaluable map; round-two cap-deficit reversals prevent treating the wording itself as evidence, but do not strictly refute every possible transport.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Let a be determined by binom(a,2)<=alpha<binom(a+1,2), and let t(a) be the least integer with binom(t,4)>=binom(a+1,3). Every actual (++ -> ++) target state satisfies e>=binom(t(a),3). Monotonicity then gives U_3(e)>=binom(t(a),4)>=binom(a+1,3)>U_2(alpha).
would_close: G++ without requiring the false cubic size bound on e
mechanisms.kill_test: Minimize the exact integer gap e-binom(t(a),3) on residue-compatible moving-wall states; kill on its first negative value and separately verify every monotonicity/cap inequality in the envelope.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/GPP_PFREE_COUNTEREXAMPLE.json: actual (++ -> ++) state (j,k,r)=(21,4,26466) has nested envelope gap below zero and U_3(e)-U_2(alpha)-1=-136419183, although exact gamma5=859354068710>0.

mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/negative_rank6_wall_probe.json and evidence/negative_rank6_walls_far.json: the first targeted probe has 13,322 gamma5-negative actual states through j=55, and the bounded far probe has 17,483 more at j in {56,60,64,80,100,120}; none has P<0 or V<0. The far probe also has 2,304 gamma5/gamma6 double negatives, so non-borrow is applicability rather than recovery. Finite evidence only.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Whenever an actual (-- -> ++) state has gamma5<0 and P,V>=0, its exact rank-six gain dominates -gamma5 and hence gamma6>=0.
would_close: two-row recovery of the gamma5-negative final chamber together with M304
mechanisms.kill_test: Minimize gamma6 and gamma6+gamma5 separately on moving negative fibres; kill on the first negative value and do not infer universality from a bounded box.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/K4_R9_RANK6_COUNTERFAMILY.json: for every odd j>=33 the actual c=1 family (k,r,u)=(4,9,12) has gamma5=1283187-4q<0 and gamma6=869828292418-4q<0; j=33 is a literal witness.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: All actual c=1 states admit a finite exhaustive split into fixed-k, k=o(sqrt(h)) unbounded, k~lambda sqrt(h), and boundary regimes, with a uniform recovery certificate in each.

mechanisms.status_evidence: A finite order relation alphabet alone does not bound translated index gaps or certify the polynomial signs; no strict counterexample to finiteness of order relations is claimed.
